description.en:
Changes the strength of the out-of-focus blur ("boke") that is already on, over a number of frames, without turning it on or off.
It is never called by the shipped scripts.
Length of the transition, in frames.

true once the transition has been started.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Softening the dialogue blur mid-scene (not found in script_clean/; invented)
